verdict.rationale: Visalaw AI, the firm's own AI product, states a 'no data retention' posture, which directly addresses retention, but only as a single marketing line. Nothing documents user-facing controls for setting retention periods or deleting data. missing for 10: user-configurable retention settings, documented deletion/export controls, retention policy documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-retention claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Visalaw AI is practice-safe AI: SOC 2 Type II certified, no data retention, and built for confidentiality
